The Hands-Off Dividend Snowball

Step-by-step, plain-language blueprints on how to turn your savings into an automated wealth-building machine that pays you every month.

01

Open a Zero-Fee Tax Shelter

Never pay a 2% bank mutual fund toll. Use a zero-commission TFSA/RRSP on Wealthsimple for stocks, and stick to regulated front doors like Coinbase for digital assets.

Claim Wealthsimple Bonus (MOPFYX) ↗ Safe Crypto Entry: Coinbase (FGP2JND) ↗
02

Buy Eating Sardines Only

Ignore hype coins and Greater-Fool fads. Buy businesses with real assets, wide margins of safety, and a track record of raising cash payouts every year.

03

Flip On Automatic DRIP

Turn on Dividend Reinvestment (DRIP). Every quarterly payout automatically buys more shares—which then pay you even more dividends next quarter.

04

Let Mr. Market Tantrum

When Mr. Market panics and puts great companies on sale for 50 cents on the dollar, your automated monthly transfer simply scoops up twice as many shares.

01 // ZOMBIE SUBSCRIPTIONS $35 / mo

The Mission of the Republic

For decades, Wall Street has operated like an interplanetary casino—charging everyday people up-front fees and commissions every time the roulette wheel spins, while hiding simple cash-flow truths behind $3,000 out-of-print books and acronyms like EBITDA.

We built the Republic of We—a parent holding company, comedy-infused book-analysis podcast hosted by Nick Gold and Barnaby (Bex) Vance, and The We Accord newsletter—to tear down those barriers.

"First rule of Value Club: Don't lose money. Second rule of Value Club: Never forget Rule Number One."

FLAGSHIP DISPATCH #01

Why the 40-Year Hustle Is Dead, and How the Republic Builds Passive Income Instead

The old social contract said: work 40 years for one company, hand your savings to a guy in a mahogany office charging a 2% annual fee, and hope the market doesn't drop 30% the year you turn 65.

In the Republic of We, we flip that script. Instead of gambling on trading sardines or paying Wall Street gatekeepers every time the roulette wheel spins, citizens build a transparent, automated dividend snowball.

Every dollar you put into cash-flowing assets with a 30,000-pound Margin of Safety goes to work immediately—paying you quarterly and monthly dividends that automatically buy more shares while you sleep.

⚖️ THE NO SH**, SHERLOCK LEGAL DISCLAIMER

We’re two voices with microphones, a cartoon dragon, and a stack of finance books—not your financial advisors, your accountants, your lawyers, or your psychic mediums. Everything in the Republic of We is strictly for comedy, book criticism, and plain-English education. You are the captain of your own wallet: do your own homework, make your own decisions, and if you bet your rent money because a podcast made a Scrooge McDuck or whoopee cushion joke, that is between you and the universe.
